checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=22 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.32 tightness=0.79 base_volume_vs_leg=0.91 base_volume_vs_avg=0.97
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)
checks.note: base of 22 sessions is outside Bonde's 3-20

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: base over 21 sessions: +CV applies, volume must be >= 1.5x average and a catalyst is needed, which bars cannot show

notes: extension: close 0.5% vs its 20-SMA, 0.2% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 0 of 1 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: Both RE and VOL are hard FAILs: the burst bar's range is only 54% of the prior five bars' largest, and volume came in below the prior session and well below the 50-session average at a time when the 22-session base explicitly requires 1.5x average volume. The base itself is a PARTIAL (22 sessions, outside the 3–20 window, tightness 0.79 vs 0.7 A+ threshold), and looking at the shaded box on the chart the consolidation shows multiple overlapping red and green bars with no clear tightening — the base is wide and choppy rather than orderly. The signal bar itself is essentially flat (close change -0.06%) with no real expansion, making this a very weak dollar-scan admission with two quality FAILs and a PARTIAL on consolidation.
claude.key_risk: Two hard checklist FAILs (RE and VOL) mean there is no genuine momentum burst here — the 'signal' bar is a near-unchanged day with below-average volume and no range expansion.
claude.entry_note: Skip if the open is below the signal day's close of 148.69 or if volume in the first 30 minutes is tracking below average, confirming the lack of conviction.
